channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jose Juan Barea | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jose Juan Barea from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Jose Juan Barea
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Mavs president of basketball ops Donnie Nelson:

“A little bit of a sad day in Mavsville as we say goodbye to J.J. Barea. … We’ve had an incredible, amazing ride with J.J.”

Donnie Nelson on Jose Juan Barea, Dec 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Jose Juan Barea
item.description:
Brad Townsend:Carlisle on Barea:

“When you look at what he's accomplished in his career as an undrafted player, it's really a remarkable career. Just flat-out. . . What he's done has been absolutely incredible. His presence on our team is important for a lot of reasons.”

Rick Carlisle on Jose Juan Barea, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Jose Juan Barea
item.description:
“It’s going to be a long road,but I defy anyone to bet against J. J. Barea on anything. It’s a great challenge, but he’s taken them on his whole life and his whole career.”

Rick Carlisle on Jose Juan Barea, Jan 15, 2019. Source: mavs.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Jose Juan Barea
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on JJ Barca’s torn Achilles:

“It’s gut-wrenching for all of us. ... I really do believe that he’ll be back [next season], but it’s hard to put into words what JJ Barea has meant to the Mavericks.”

Rick Carlisle on Jose Juan Barea, Jan 13, 2019. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Jose Juan Barea
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle on Barea (hamstring):

“Barea is doing better. He did some noncontact things and did some full court running today. He’ll be back at some point but we’re not going to put him out there until he’s absolutely 100 percent and has at least 1 or 2 practices under his belt.”

Rick Carlisle on Jose Juan Barea, Sep 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Devin Harris on Jose Juan Barea
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Devin Harris on J.J. Barea:

“He's got a little-man syndrome from the start. That's just who he is. I don't ever want him to change.”

Devin Harris on Jose Juan Barea, Mar 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Andrew Bynum on Jose Juan Barea
item.description:
“Furthermore, and more importantly, I want to actually apologize to J.J. Barea for doing that. I'm just glad that he wasn't seriously injured in the event and all I can say is, I've looked at [the replay], it's terrible and it definitely won't be happening again.”

Andrew Bynum on Jose Juan Barea, May 10, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.
